abort_condition: Abort and reject the run if training or validation produces a non-finite value, the official executor exceeds its runtime limit, or the configuration differs from the listed parameters. Do not retry with extra seeds or inspect hidden-test data.
acceptance: Evaluate only on the fixed validation split and report both GAUC and nDCG@5. Accept if primary is at least 0.6054932136535645, which is the observed champion primary 0.6034932136535645 plus epsilon 0.002; otherwise reject.
change_summary: Train one seed-0 NumPy FM with positive_weight=2.5 instead of the champion's 2.0. Keep k=16, lr=0.001, epochs=40, batch_size=8192, patience=4, and all other behavior fixed.
hypothesis: Increasing only the positive-example logistic-loss weight from 2.0 to 2.5 will improve the KuaiRand-Pure long_view validation primary score by at least 0.002 relative to the current champion.
rationale: The only completed positive-weight experiment improved the primary score when the weight moved from 1.0 to 2.0. A conservative one-step increase tests whether that trend continues without the runtime risk of the previously failed three-model ensemble. This is a single-seed, single-model run and does not assume an unobserved metric result.
title: Tune champion positive weight from 2.0 to 2.5
